title: Concept: ClickHouse error detail disclosed in a response
description: A ClickHouse exception with its error code in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The exception number and text identify the engine and often the failing clause, which narrows an injection attempt on the reporting path.
applicability: Deployments that render a ClickHouse exception with its error code into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The exception number and text identify the engine and often the failing clause, which narrows an injection attempt on the reporting path.
